- The right-side sprite is a creature (4×4 b-b-S-S, pulsing, blinks purple on pattern completion). The left-side sprite is its "home" (a larger version of the same shape).
- The green edge bar is proportional to the distance between the creature and home (128px ↔ 23 columns) — a timer: the creature slowly walks left (about 2 columns per ~80 seconds), and the bar shrinks in sync.
- Pattern completion (4 diamond clicks) is accepted and makes the creature blink; the 2nd completion also moved the creature 2 to the left (or that was time-based walking).
- LEFT moved the creature 4 to the left (single frame, no flash) — the arrow keys move the creature, i.e., they advance the timer. Stop using arrow keys.
- Goal hypothesis: before the creature reaches home, complete the diamond pattern N times (target ~36 actions ≈ 9 completions × 4 clicks).
- Plan: batch 2 more pattern completions (8 clicks), then check for level completion and the creature's position.
